scope: Bounded official election-source verification: six dated elections (three national, one state and two local processes), plus one explicitly conditional House runoff date. Not a global electoral calendar.
method: Fifteen inherited-proxy HTTPS urllib requests with normal TLS verification; official pages parsed with Python standard HTMLParser, public Taiwan __NUXT_DATA__ calendarList decoded with json.loads and indexed references, and FEC PDF extracted with pdftotext. Date-relevant text/data inspected by an AI agent. No external search service, browser automation, challenge bypass, party matching, electoral prediction or candidate profiling used.

sources.title: 2026 Congressional Primary Dates and Candidate Filing Deadlines for Ballot Access
sources.support: Header explicitly states the national congressional general election date. Louisiana House runoff row lists 12/12 under RUNOFF DATE (IF NECESSARY).
limitations: The document states Dates Subject to Change and Data as of 5/18/2026. Retrieval on 29 October is not a new state-by-state confirmation.
This is a federal congressional schedule, not a complete calendar of state/local elections or polling-place opening times.

sources.title: IEC official homepage
sources.support: Main dated election heading and forthcoming-election forum text name 5 December 2026.
limitations: Homepage countdown includes a generic Election in Progress string; that widget is not used to determine whether voting has started.
Official dated event and 15 October news pages below give stronger event-specific support.

sources.title: CEC English homepage
sources.support: Discovery only. Its English news is old; it is not used as support for the election date.
limitations: English homepage does not provide the current upcoming-election date in the inspected main text. Native-language current decision is used instead.

sources.title: Presidential Election Day

sources.support: Dedicated official event gives the election day.
limitations: Event page lists 08:00–17:00 but no explicit time-zone identifier. The research feature should keep this as a date-only event and should not assume a nationwide or individual polling-place instant.

sources.title: IEC Officials Discuss Electoral Preparations Ahead of December 5, 2026 Presidential Election
sources.excerpt: ahead of Election Day on 5 December 2026.
sources.support: Dated official news independently reiterates the date on the dedicated event page.
limitations: Preparation notice verifies the listed date, not an outcome, candidate preference or election-day status.

sources.title: CEC Bulgarian homepage
sources.excerpt: за новия избор (втори тур) за президент и вицепрезидент на републиката на 1 ноември 2026 г.
sources.translation: for the new election (second round) for president and vice-president of the republic on 1 November 2026
sources.support: Current official home page links 29 October decision 425 and names the second-round date.
limitations: Native-language text read with an AI translation/paraphrase; this is not a certified translation.
First-round 25 October is before the reference window and must not be listed as upcoming.

sources.title: Решение № 425-ПВР, 29 October 2026
sources.excerpt: за новия избор (втори тур) за президент и вицепрезидент на републиката на 1 ноември 2026 г.
sources.translation: for the new election (second round) for president and vice-president of the republic on 1 November 2026
sources.support: Decision subject explicitly identifies the presidential/vice-presidential second round on 1 November; the decision concerns overseas polling commissions.
limitations: Only the subject and date-relevant introductory/operative paragraphs were read; personal appointments and all annex rows were not independently audited.
No election outcome or candidate judgment is extracted.

sources.title: 2026 state election
sources.excerpt: Saturday 28 November Election day - voting open 8 am to 6 pm
sources.support: Official 2026 state election timeline names Saturday 28 November as election day.
limitations: This is the state of Victoria, not an Australian federal election.
Only date and scope are used. Electoral information elsewhere on the source page is not copied as product voting advice.
The date-only event should use a separately labelled study sample rather than treating noon as the election start.

sources.title: 404 - Sauce not found
sources.excerpt: The page you are looking for might have been removed, had its name changed, or is temporarily unavailable.
sources.support: No upcoming-event claim supported. HTTP 200 is a soft 404.
limitations: Do not count this response as successful federal election-calendar verification.

sources.title: 2026 general election public URL — access challenge response
sources.support: No date verified. Response body is a 212-byte Incapsula script challenge with no substantive election text.
limitations: HTTP 200 does not establish election-calendar access. No challenge, cookie, proxy or direct-route bypass attempted.
The proposed 7 November date remains unverified by this subtask and is not added as an event.

sources.excerpt: Freedom House 2026 Report: Taiwan Scores 93, Ranks 2nd in Asia for Global Freedom
sources.support: Discovery only. No 2026 local election date was present in inspected English main text or serialized content.
limitations: Not used as election-date evidence. Native official calendar record below supplies the date.

No New Zealand election event is included without source-readable date support.

sources.title: CEC official Chinese homepage — serialized election calendar
sources.translation: Voting for the year-115 local public-office elections (ROC year 115 is 2026). The explicit serialized date is 20261128.
sources.support: The public homepage HTML includes a calendarList containing calendarId 56, date 20261128 and the local-election title. Values were decoded with JSON parsing and indexed references, without executing site code or making extra API calls.
limitations: The visible homepage shows only a nearby-week calendar; the future date was read from the official serialized calendar state.
Native Chinese title translated/paraphrased by an AI agent, not a certified translator.
This is local public-office voting across jurisdictions, not a presidential election, and does not define a single event instant.

sources.publisher: Oficina Nacional de Procesos Electorales, Peru
sources.title: Asistencia técnica de la ONPE permitirá que más de dos mil centros poblados elijan sus autoridades
sources.excerpt: este 1 de noviembre de 2026, la elección de autoridades en 2,262 centros poblados.
sources.translation: on 1 November 2026, the election of authorities in 2,262 populated centres.
sources.support: Dated ONPE press release explicitly states the date and local-centre scope; municipal provincial authorities organize these elections with ONPE technical assistance.
limitations: This is a local-centre authority election, not the regional governor runoff or a national presidential election. No Peru regional-runoff date was independently established.
Lima is only an illustrative study observer; it does not represent every affected centre.
Source describes Huachipa hours separately, but no single national election timestamp is inferred.

events.title: Bulgaria presidential and vice-presidential election — second round
notes: Source confirms second round; first-round 25 October is past relative to 29 October.
Any noon sample is chosen for study and is not an election timestamp.

events.title: Peru populated-centre local authority elections
notes: ONPE 28 October release states 1 November voting in 2,262 populated centres.
These elections are organized by provincial municipalities with ONPE technical assistance; they are not the regional governor runoff.
Noon in Lima is an illustrative chosen sample, not a shared timestamp or representative chart of all centres.

events.title: United States congressional general election
notes: FEC source data dated 18 May; dates subject to change notice retained.
This national date spans multiple time zones and does not define one event instant.

events.title: Victoria state election, Australia
notes: A regional/state election, not a federal election.
Noon sample is not the official start; opening hours are retained only in the source receipt.

events.title: Taiwan local public-office elections
notes: Date decoded from the official homepage public calendarList record, calendarId 56.
Local elections, not a presidential election. Any noon/capital sample is explicitly illustrative, not an event timestamp.

events.title: The Gambia presidential election
notes: Official event and dated 15 October preparation notice agree on 5 December.
Retain date-only precision even though the event page prints unzoned opening hours.

events.title: Louisiana United States House runoff — if necessary

This is not confirmation that a runoff will take place in every or any district.

coverage.caveat: Unchecked means no independent source work in this bounded subtask, not no election. AU has only a verified Victoria state event here; Australian federal coverage is not established. EU and African Union are organizations, not countries. Membership definitions require a separately cited cohort source.

interpretationBoundary: Event dates are factual calendar records. Any historical astrological context must use an explicitly chosen study instant and observer; it is not a winner, outcome or causal forecast. No one nationwide timestamp is inferred from a date-only record.
storage: Only short excerpts, public source metadata and hashes committed. Downloaded source bodies and extracted working text remain outside Git under /tmp/election-source-check.

extension.reason: Parent requested verified New Zealand, Taiwan and Peru breadth beyond the initial four dated elections. New Zealand responses were access challenges; Taiwan and a distinct Peru local process were source-verified.
extension.operationalTotalBound: Initial nine requests plus at most six authorized extension requests were made (15 actual); declared ledger upper bound raised to 18 as requested, without using the extra three.
